app.name: KaamPass
app.introduction: Maharaton, agreements aur tasdeeq shuda kaam ke liye bharosaymand profile.

language.label: Zabaan
language.saveError: Zabaan ki pasand save nahi hui. Dobara koshish karein.

auth.passwordHint: Kam az kam 8 characters istemal karein.
auth.switchToRegister: KaamPass par naye hain? Account banayein
auth.switchToLogin: Pehle se account hai? Sign in karein
auth.loading: Aap ka account khul raha hai…
auth.invalid: Apni maloomat check karein. Naye account ke password mein kam az kam 8 characters hone chahiye.
auth.failed: Yeh kaam mukammal nahi hua. Maloomat check karke dobara koshish karein.
auth.confirmEmail: Account confirm karne ke liye email check karein, phir sign in karein.
auth.unavailable: Session mil gaya, lekin account ki tafseel load nahi hui. API aur Supabase check karke page dobara load karein.
auth.loginIntro: Apni private profile aur jobs ke liye email aur password se sign in karein.
auth.registerIntro: Worker ya employer account banayein. Sign in ke baad professional tafseel mukammal karein.
auth.accountReady: Aap {{role}} ke taur par sign in hain. Agla safha chunein.

errors.fullNameRequired: Account banane se pehle apna poora naam likhein.
errors.invalidEmail: Mukammal email address likhein, jaise name@example.com.
errors.passwordRequired: Sign in karne ke liye password likhein.
errors.passwordTooShort: Naye password mein kam az kam 8 characters rakhein.
errors.invalidCredentials: Email ya password ghalat hai. Dono fields check karke dobara koshish karein.
errors.emailNotConfirmed: Sign in se pehle apna email confirm karein.
errors.accountExists: Is email ka account pehle se mojood hai. Sign in istemal karein.
errors.rateLimited: Bohat zyada koshishain hui hain. Ek minute ruk kar dobara koshish karein.
errors.network: Authentication service se rabta nahi ho saka. Connection aur local services check karein.
errors.signInUnavailable: Sign in filhal dastiyab nahi. Supabase check karke dobara koshish karein.
errors.signUpUnavailable: Account nahi ban saka. Supabase Auth check karke dobara koshish karein.
errors.signOutFailed: Sign out mukammal nahi hua. Connection check karke dobara koshish karein.

home.title: Apna kaam ka record saath le kar chalein.
home.intro: Apne peshe ki profile banayein, phir tay shuda kaam ko tasdeeq shuda tajurbe mein badlein.
home.signedInIntro: Aap ka account tayyar hai. Profile kholein ya jobs par jayein.
home.statusHelp: KaamPass account aur profile request se pehle API check karta hai.

gates.profileTitle: Profile dekhne ke liye sign in karein.
gates.profileBody: Aap ki professional aur account maloomat sign in tak private rehti hai.
gates.jobsTitle: Jobs dekhne ke liye sign in karein.
gates.jobsBody: Agreements aur job ki tafseel sirf mutaliqa afrad dekh sakte hain.

jobs.title: Jobs agla qadam hain.
jobs.empty: Agreement banana, worker ka jawab aur active jobs Module 3 mein shamil honge. Aap ki profile is workflow ke liye tayyar hai.

history.title: Tasdeeq shuda kaam ki history
history.privateHint: Adaigi ki tafseel sirf aap dekh sakte hain. Tasdeeq ka matlab dono ne kaam aur adaigi maani hai.
history.repeatHint: Repeat employer ne aap ke saath do ya zyada kaam tasdeeq kiye hain.
history.empty: Aap ka tasdeeq shuda kaam yahan nazar aayega.
history.loading: Kaam ki history load ho rahi hai…
history.error: Kaam ki history load nahi hui.

completion.amountPaidInput: Pehle se ada ki gayi raqam (PKR)
completion.employerHint: Kaam ke asal din aur pehle se ada ki gayi raqam darj karein. Worker dono ki tasdeeq karega.
completion.workerHint: Sirf tab tasdeeq karein jab upar diya gaya kaam aur payment durust hon. Tasdeeq se verified record banega.

errors.invalid: 1 se 365 din aur durust payment darj karein, zyada se zyada do ashari maqamat ke saath.
errors.changed: Kaam ki haalat badal chuki hai. Page refresh karke dobara dekhein.
errors.session: Session khatam ho gaya. Dobara sign in karein.
errors.save: Jawab save nahi hua. Connection check karke dobara koshish karein.

agreements.employerTitle: Kaam shuru hone se pehle wazeh sharaait tay karein.
agreements.workerTitle: Jawab dene se pehle har shart check karein.
agreements.employerIntro: Worker chunein, kaam likhein aur qeemat, muddat aur material ki wazeh agreement bhejein.
agreements.workerIntro: Sirf aap apni worker profile ko bheji gayi agreement qabool ya rad kar sakte hain.
agreements.directTitle: Pehle se maloom worker ko seedha hire karein
agreements.directIntro: Jab aap pehle se jaante hon ke agreement kis worker ko bhejni hai.
agreements.createIntro: Hisab shuda total server par final amount ke taur par save hota hai.
agreements.noActiveJobs: Abhi koi kaam shuru nahi hua. Agreement qabool hone par kaam shuru hota hai.
agreements.noWorkers: Abhi koi mukammal worker profile dastiyab nahi hai.

errors.invalid: Worker, tafseel, din, qeemat aur peshe ki khas maloomat check karein.
errors.loadFailed: Agreements load nahi ho sakein. API check karke dobara koshish karein.
errors.saveFailed: Agreement ki tabdeeli save nahi hui. Koi shart nahi badli.

errors.notFound: Yeh agreement dastiyab nahi ya aap ke account se mutaliq nahi hai.

marketplace.employerTitle: Masla post karein aur asal bids compare karein.
marketplace.workerTitle: Apne peshe se milta kaam dhoondein.

marketplace.postHelp: Sirf broad service area likhein. Phone number, poora pata ya private contact na likhein.
marketplace.title: Mukhtasar title
marketplace.description: Masla aur matlooba nateeja bayan karein
marketplace.imageHelp: 3 mein se {{count}} select. JPEG, PNG ya WebP; har image 5 MB tak. Chehre, pate aur private documents na dikhayein.
marketplace.noEmployerPosts: Aap ne abhi koi kaam request post nahi ki.
marketplace.noWorkerPosts: Abhi aap ke peshe se milti koi open request nahi hai.
marketplace.bidAmount: Aap ka rate ya fixed amount (PKR)
marketplace.noBids: Abhi kisi worker ne bid nahi di.

errors.invalidBid: Durust qeemat aur andazati din darj karein.
errors.loadFailed: Kaam requests load nahi ho sakein. API check karke dobara koshish karein.
errors.saveFailed: Marketplace tabdeeli save nahi hui. Dobara koshish karein.
errors.network: Marketplace service se rabta nahi ho saka.
errors.profileRequired: Aage barhne se pehle sahi employer ya worker profile mukammal karein.
errors.bidExists: Aap is request par pehle hi bid bhej chuke hain.

errors.selectionFailed: Worker select nahi ho saka. Koi agreement nahi bani.
